title: Knesset committee meeting, 30 minutes — tasks agreed, against three reviewers

files.path: one public committee session's audio file (chosen at pin time)

license.note: Knesset committee recordings published by ivrit.ai; the dataset card's terms are read at pin time. The audio is never committed: only this manifest and the reviewers' task lists (text written by the reviewers).

split: one 30-minute excerpt (start and end in the review file)
normalizer: none (tasks are matched by word overlap, meetingCore.sameTask)
owed: pin: on a machine with network, pick one committee session from the dataset's file list, record its path and sha256 and the dataset revision (40-hex) here, and the 30-minute start/end in the review file
review (W11.O5): three people listen to the excerpt and each writes the tasks agreed in it, one per line, into the review file; a task counts when two of the three wrote it
run: record the excerpt through the meeting recorder (or feed the file), then `npm run eval:meeting-tasks -- --note <the meeting note> --review eval/reviews/meeting-knesset-committees.review.json`
